item.title: Dharan Satellite Bootcamp
item.description:
Overview

The Dharan Satellite Bootcamp was a 4-day hands-on STEM training for school students (classes 7–10) focused on satellite design and technology.

📅 Training Schedule

  • Day 1: Basics of Electronics — resistors, capacitors, transistors, and circuit theory
  • Day 2: Practical soldering, CubeSat structure, payload, OBC, EPS, power system, and mission overview
  • Day 3: Programming and sensor interfacing for real-time data acquisition
  • Day 4: Simulated satellite deployment using a parachute and wireless data collection

🎯 Objectives

To inspire young students in space science and technology through practical learning and teamwork.

item.title: Recognition and Separation of Fresh and Rotten Fruits using YOLO Algorithm
item.description:
Overview

This project focuses on detecting and classifying fruits as fresh or rotten using the YOLOv5 deep learning algorithm.
The system uses Python, OpenCV, and PyTorch, achieving over 90% accuracy on test datasets.

Objectives

  • Build a real-time detection system for fruit classification
  • Train YOLOv5 on a custom fruit dataset
  • Separate fresh and rotten fruits automatically

Technologies Used

  • YOLOv5
  • Python
  • OpenCV
  • PyTorch

Results

Achieved high accuracy and real-time processing speed.
